title: Malformed-plan suite
purpose: Systematically inject structural and closed-shape defects and assert the declared fail-closed outcome, code, target, and the absence of a decoded plan as a distinct family from the T019 NEG-D* set.
inputs: the committed fixture mutated at declared offsets
outputs: declared outcome, code, and absent plan
errors: assertion failure if a defect is accepted or a value is returned
invariants: no malformed case returns a plan
no T019 case is edited or weakened

unit_cases.precondition: the fixture body truncated at several byte offsets
unit_cases.expected: rejected XCOM-DECODE-INPUT at xcom-plan with no plan (T20-MAL-01)

unit_cases.precondition: a body with a dropped/duplicated closing brace or bracket
a body with appended {}, trailing text, or a second document
a repeated member at top level, provenance, policies, and endpoints[]
a collection as an object and scalars as arrays
unit_cases.expected: rejected XCOM-DECODE-SHAPE at the affected object with no plan (T20-MAL-06)

unit_cases.precondition: null for policies, provenance, contracts, inputResolution
unit_cases.expected: rejected XCOM-DECODE-SHAPE at the affected object with no plan (T20-MAL-07)

unit_cases.precondition: each of the 16 required members dropped in turn
unit_cases.expected: rejected XCOM-DECODE-SHAPE at xcom-plan with no plan (T20-MAL-08)

unit_cases.precondition: one unknown member in each nested object location
unit_cases.expected: rejected XCOM-DECODE-SHAPE at the affected object with no plan (T20-MAL-09)

unit_cases.precondition: a lone 0xFF byte inside a string value
an empty and a whitespace-only document
a document nested above the default max_depth
every malformed-plan vector in the suite
unit_cases.stimulus: re-run the aggregate guard over each outcome
unit_cases.expected: no case returns a plan and none reports accepted (T20-MAL-13)

unit_cases.precondition: the T019 decoder_negative_tests.cpp file hash and tokens
unit_cases.expected: distinct T20-MAL family; T019 file SHA-256 and NEG-D* tokens unchanged (T20-MAL-14)

static_checks.rule: cppcheck --error-exitcode=1 --quiet --std=c++20 --language=c++ --suppress=invalidLifetime src/xverse/xcom/src/activation_plan.cpp reports no error/portability defect in the consumed T019 decoder source built into the T020 suites

static_checks.tool: GNU g++ 11.4.0 via CMake target xverse_xcom_activation_plan_t020_<kind>_tests with xverse_xcom_apply_warnings
static_checks.rule: the T020 test target compiles under the project strict warning flags with no warning and no error

note: The T019 distinctness guard reads the T019 negative-test file read-only and pins its SHA-256.
